questions.stem: A female patient presents with active genital warts with a history of recurrence, but her husband doesn't have it. What advice will you give to prevent transmission?

options.label: A
options.text: Give continuous prophylaxis to the patient

options.label: B
options.text: Give prophylactic anti-virals to the husband

options.label: C
options.text: Give anti-virals whenever active lesions are present

options.label: D
options.text: Don't involve in intercourse when active lesions are present
